payload.text: When I was nine, Ashgrove Creek flooded our street twice in one spring. My grandmother and I pushed bamboo stakes into the mud each morning to mark how far the water had climbed, and reading those stakes was the first time measuring something felt like looking after people instead of doing arithmetic.
